<module id="adder_pipe_64bit">
    <description>64-bit ripple carry adder with pipelining stages.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="i_en">Enable signal for addition operation.</input>
        <input id="adda" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand A.</input>
        <input id="addb" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit input operand B.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[64:0]">65-bit output representing the sum of adda and addb.</output>
        <output id="o_en">Output enable signal indicating the availability of the result.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="IDLE">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter name="STAGE1">First pipeline stage.</parameter>
        <parameter name="STAGE2">Second pipeline stage.</parameter>
        <parameter name="STAGE3">Third pipeline stage.</parameter>
        <parameter name="STAGE4">Fourth pipeline stage.</parameter>
        <parameter name="WIDTH">64</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state" width="3">Current state of the FSM.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width="3">Next state of the FSM.</reg>
        <reg id="enable_reg" width="1">Register for enabling the addition operation.</reg>
        <reg id="adda_reg" width="64">Register for storing the first input operand.</reg>
        <reg id="addb_reg" width="64">Register for storing the second input operand.</reg>
        <wire id="sum_stage1" width="65">Sum at the first pipeline stage.</wire>
        <wire id="carry_stage1" width="65">Carry at the first pipeline stage.</wire>
        <wire id="sum_stage2" width="65">Sum at the second pipeline stage.</wire>
        <wire id="carry_stage2" width="65">Carry at the second pipeline stage.</wire>
        <wire id="sum_stage3" width="65">Sum at the third pipeline stage.</wire>
        <wire id="carry_stage3" width="65">Carry at the third pipeline stage.</wire>
        <wire id="sum_stage4" width="65">Sum at the fourth pipeline stage.</wire>
        <wire id="carry_stage4" width="65">Carry at the fourth pipeline stage.</wire>
        <wire id="final_sum" width="65">Final sum after all pipeline stages.</wire>
        <wire id="final_carry" width="65">Final carry after all pipeline stages.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                current_state <= IDLE;
            end else begin
                current_state <= next_state;
            end
        end

        always @(*) begin
            case (current_state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (i_en) begin
                        next_state = STAGE1;
                        enable_reg = 1;
                        adda_reg = adda;
                        addb_reg = addb;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                        enable_reg = 0;
                    end
                end
                STAGE1: begin
                    next_state = STAGE2;
                    sum_stage1 = adda_reg + addb_reg;
                    carry_stage1 = {sum_stage1[64], sum_stage1[63:0]};
                end
                STAGE2: begin
                    next_state = STAGE3;
                    sum_stage2 = sum_stage1 + carry_stage1;
                    carry_stage2 = {sum_stage2[64], sum_stage2[63:0]};
                end
                STAGE3: begin
                    next_state = STAGE4;
                    sum_stage3 = sum_stage2 + carry_stage2;
                    carry_stage3 = {sum_stage3[64], sum_stage3[63:0]};
                end
                STAGE4: begin
                    next_state = IDLE;
                    sum_stage4 = sum_stage3 + carry_stage3;
                    carry_stage4 = {sum_stage4[64], sum_stage4[63:0]};
                    final_sum = sum_stage4;
                    final_carry = carry_stage4;
                end
                default: begin
                    next_state = IDLE;
                end
            endcase
        end

        // Output logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                o_en <= 0;
                result <= 65'b0;
            end else begin
                if (current_state == IDLE && next_state == STAGE1) begin
                    o_en <= 1;
                    result <= final_sum;
                end else begin
                    o_en <= 0;
                    result <= 65'b0;
                end
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
